name: Starbucks
tips: Never oat drink: the guide lists oats as a gluten cereal.
Any other milk is fine: skimmed, semi-skimmed, whole, almond, soya or coconut.
Swap means the drink normally comes with oat drink, so ask for another milk.
gaps: Starbucks doesn't call any drink gluten free. This app lists drinks whose ingredients contain no gluten cereals.
The guide lists ingredients only. It says nothing about which drinks may contain traces of gluten.
Food isn't covered. This guide is for drinks, syrups and toppings only.
